date.as_written: samvat 1903 sāla samvat 1768 nepāla (nepāla 966) sālam vaisāṣavadi (!) 30 roja 2

notes: The date provides three year counts: VS 1903, ŚS 1768 (erroneously labelled 'nepāla' in the original text), and NS 966 (corrected in parentheses). Vaiśākha kṛṣṇa 30 on roja 2 (Monday) corresponds precisely to 25 May 1846 CE. 'ghāsaṃyā' indicates the scribe's residence/tol (Ghāsaṃ + Newari genitive suffix -yā).
